title: Import Staging, Easier to Find
subtitle: Moves the Import Staging tab next to Transactions and puts a review banner on the Dashboard that links to it. One menu run, then one more to pull in the car payment.
intro: After the pull request merges, the code is already in your Sheet. These steps move the tab, draw the banner, and apply the new car-payment rule.
**What does not change:** no rows, balances, categories, tab names or column headers. The Dashboard keeps your Selected Month and checklist ticks.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before review banner 2026-11-09`.
steps.note: If anything looks wrong afterwards, File → Version history → See version history lets you restore this point.

steps.text: Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm. It takes about a minute.
steps.note: If the menu says the upgrade is already current, wait a minute and run it again; the deploy may still have been landing.

steps.text: Check the tab strip at the bottom: **Import Staging** now sits right after **Transactions**.
steps.done: Import Staging is the ninth tab, between Transactions and Recurring Payments.

steps.text: Open the **Dashboard**. Row 11, just under Selected Month, is a banner. Amber means bank rows are waiting; green means the staging tab is clear. Click the banner once: it should jump to Import Staging.
steps.done: The banner reads something like "9 bank transaction(s) waiting for your review" and clicking it opens Import Staging.

steps.text: Open **Finance Tracker → Re-apply rules to waiting rows**. The new rule RULE-001 catches the "CAPITAL ONE AUTO - DIRECTPAY" row and imports it as a Debt Payment on your car loan.
steps.done: The message says 1 waiting row updated. On Transactions, a new row shows the $286.47 car payment with Type Debt Payment; the Dashboard banner count drops by one.

steps.text: Optional: for each other waiting row you recognise (Venmo, Acorns, Fidelity, the paychecks), click the row on Import Staging and run **Finance Tracker → Make a rule from the selected row…**. Pick the Type and Category, tick **Always auto-import** if it should never need you again, and save.
steps.note: Paychecks: Type Income, Category Income, Subcategory Salary, Person Ben or Valerie. Acorns and Fidelity: Type Savings with the matching fund. Venmo depends on what it was, so leave those without auto-import.
